name: xTool F2 Ultra
tagline: Next-gen compact fiber + diode : faster metal marking, larger than F1
tldr: xTool's updated dual-laser desktop builds on F1 Ultra with improved speed and workflow. Still a metal-marking specialist with small default bed. Premium price for jewelry, tools, and batch metal personalization : not a general workshop replacement.
mainObjective: High-speed compact metal marking plus bonus diode for wood & leather

faq.question: F2 Ultra vs F1 Ultra : worth upgrading?
faq.answer: If you already run F1 Ultra at production capacity, F2's speed gains may justify it. New buyers should compare bundle pricing : F1 Ultra discounts may offer better value if speed difference is not critical.

moduleSystem.headline: High-power dual laser (MOPA fiber + diode)
moduleSystem.description: F2 Ultra pairs MOPA fiber for metal/color marking with a 40W-class diode for organics. Dual-source hybrid, not interchangeable wattage tiers.

editorialDepth.advantages: xTool F2 Ultra 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU : clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame : glasses and exhaust required. Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.
